decisions.reason: As a low-cost accessory closely tied to the firm’s installed trailer base, it likely stays because there is no clear sign of performance below aspiration and it uses little organisational slack.

This box car trailer series fits the firm’s core capabilities and its home-page promotion suggests strategic importance, so management would likely keep it while early market results remain uncertain.

The car transporter trailer line is more niche and therefore somewhat riskier, but it still leverages existing production know-how and service channels, which argues for continued trial rather than immediate withdrawal.

The low-bed trailer series serves professional hauling needs aligned with the firm’s main business, and a medium-sized established manufacturer would usually allow more time before judging it a failure.
The high trailer cover series complements existing trailer products and can be supported through the current network, so the firm is likely to retain it unless clear shortfalls emerge.
Although another box car trailer series may create overlap and raises the chance of later pruning, its close fit with the firm’s portfolio and prominent marketing support keeping it for now.
